title: DISCOVERING YOUR NEW SELF( PART II)

blocks.text: Introduction: Now that you have, by Grace of God, become a child of God, you must now learn to live and operate successfully in your new home. This is necessary because the kind of life you were living before is a sharp contrast to your new life.

cards.heading: 1. The Immediate Things God Expects From You

blocks.text: a. Put off the old man and put on the new man(Discuss) {{eph 4:20,eph 4:21,eph 4:22,eph 4:23,eph 4:24,eph 4:25,eph 4:26,eph 4:27,eph 4:28,eph 4:29,eph 4:30,eph 4:31,eph 4:32|Eph. 4:20-32}}; {{cl 3:5,cl 3:6,cl 3:7,cl 3:8,cl 3:9,cl 3:10|Col 3:5-10}} b. Break all diplomatic relations with the devil and his kingdom. {{2co 6:14,2co 6:15,2co 6:16,2co 6:17,2co 6:18|II Cor. 6: 14-18}}; {{eph 5:11,eph 5:12|Eph 5:11- 12}}; What kind of relationships are we to break? (Discuss) {{ps 1:1,ps 1:2,ps 1:3,ps 1:4,ps 1:5,ps 1:6|Ps 1:1-6}}; {{dt 7:1,dt 7:2,dt 7:3,dt 7:4,dt 7:5,dt 7:6|Deut 7: 1-6}}; {{1co 15:33|1Cor. 15:33}} c. Purify yourself, your thought and all you have on a daily basis, in order to retain God there. {{1co 3:16,1co 3:17|I Cor. 3:16-17}}; {{rm 12:1,rm 12:2|Rom. 12:1-2}}; How can these be achieved? (Discuss) {{ph 4:8,ph 4:9|Phil 4: 8-9}}; {{1pe 2:11|I Peter 2:11}}; {{jm 4:7|James 4:7}}; {{jo 17:17|John 17:17}}; thy words have I hid in my heart that I might not sin against thee. {{ps 119:11|Ps 119:11}} d. He expects you to have regular fellowship and unbroken personal relationship with him (Discuss) {{jm 4:8|James 4:8}}; Thou wilt keep in perfect peace whose mind is stayed on thee (Jesus Christ gave us a good example) {{lk 6:12|Luke 6:12}}; You should fellowship with other brethren at all times. {{hb 10:25|Heb. 10:25}}; {{act 2:42,act 2:43,act 2:44,act 2:45,act 2:46,act 2:47|Acts 2:42-47}}; {{ps 133:1,ps 133:2,ps 133:3|Ps. 133:1-3}}; Why is this type of fellowship very important? Ecc. 4:9-10; {{mt 18:19,mt 18:20|Matt 18: 19-20}}; {{dt 32:30|Deut. 32:30}}. You must do all things in FAITH in order to please God. {{gl 3:11|Gal 3:11}}; {{rm 1:17|Rom. 1:17}}; {{hb 11:6|Heb 11:6}}; {{mk 11:23,mk 11:24|Mark 11:23-24}}; discuss- what is Faith? {{hb 11:1|Heb 11:1}}; How can we receive the victorious kind of faith? {{rm 10:17|Rom. 10:17}}. Examples of victorious Faith: {{rm 4:19,rm 4:20,rm 4:21,rm 4:22|Rom 4:19-22}}; {{hb 11:17,hb 11:18,hb 11:19|Heb 11:17-19}}

cards.heading: 2. The Immediate Things You Should Expect From The World

items: The world will hate you. Discuss why? {{jo 15:18,jo 15:19|John 15:18-19}}; {{jo 17:14|John 17:14}}; {{mt 5:44,mt 5:45,mt 5:46,mt 5:47,mt 5:48|Matt 5:44-48}} (b) The world will persecute you, distinguish between persecution and accusation. {{jo 15:20,jo 15:21|John 15:20-21}}; {{jo 16:33|John 16:33}}; {{2tm 3:12|II Tim 3:12}}
The world will want to lure you into doing things of the old. {{jm 4:7|James 4:7}}; Prob 1:10-15
